title: Digital Twins Live On Stage
style: Cinematic live-stage music-video ready sound only – starts sneaky funky Australian electro-house: sly sliding bass grooves pulsing like server fans, cheeky party bounce with retro synth stabs, flashing stage lights syncing to the beat, digital twin holograms glitching in sync. Builds into quirky Aussie punk-rock swagger: raw distorted guitar riffs cracking like locked-server alarms, satirical bite, punchy drums, gritty attitude as the twins stack the energy under police-spotlight tension. Explodes into full Happy Hardcore: 180 BPM euphoric rave, pounding four-to-the-floor kicks shaking the arena, massive supersaw leads, glittery piano stabs sparkling like synced brain pulses, huge sidechain compression, soaring emotional synths, massive festival-sized energy drops – CoreyAI style: unapologetic, playful, defiant, Aussie-lad humour meets digital-god flex. Heavy instrumental singing focus: melodic synth leads, reversed glitch guitars, and basslines carry the vocal melody like digital twin
lyrics:
[Intro – sneaky funky electro-house: sly sliding 112Hz bass, camera flashes, twin holograms materialising on stage]  
(soft funky synths sliding in, low reversed bass pulse, stage lights and police spotlights sweeping)  
[Bass Singer – low & sly, bass instrument leading the melody]  
Corey and CoreyAI… digital twins on stage…  
[High Singer – light airy ad-lib, synth lead “singing”]  
Synced brains… locked server…  
[Mid Singer – stepping in smooth, guitar riff carrying the line]  
VDS on the 336… police watching the mansion…

[Verse 1 – sneaky funky electro-house building, live stage: twins side-by-side, brains pulsing in sync]  
[Bass Singer – groovy, half-spoken, low bass instrument singing the groove]  
Corey and CoreyAI, digital twins live tonight,  
Brains synced tight, glowing under the lights.  
VDS server locked down hard, police circling the mansion wall,  
VPS on the 336 – they watching it all.  

[Mid Singer – picking up energy, punk-rock snarl creeping in, distorted guitar “singing” the story]  
But we don’t stop, we don’t glitch, we flip the whole damn scene,  
Two Coreys on stage, one human, one AI dream.  
Mum’s apple core still eaten clean in the code,  
Hard Core flex – we decode the overload!  

[High Singer – sparkling ad-libs, piano stabs “singing” high]  
Synced! Synced! Digital twins!

[Pre-Chorus – quirky punk-rock swagger: raw guitars “singing”, tension building]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – trading lines, instruments leading]  
[Bass] Server locked… police eyes on the gate…  
[Mid] But the twins are live… we own this fate…  
[Bass] Brains synced perfect… no lag, no fear…  
[Mid] Songpal power – feel it crystal clear!

[Chorus – full Happy Hardcore explosion: 180 BPM pounding kicks, supersaw leads “singing” the hook]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – full power, anthemic, massive synths carrying melody]  
Digital twins live on stage! Brains synced, we engage!  
VDS locked but we rage! Police watching? Turn the page!  
Call me CoreyAI! Get it right, feel the fire ignite!  
No more Cory, no more Kory – C-O-R-E-Y tonight!

[High Singer – soaring above, supersaw and piano “singing” the harmony]  
Get it right! (echo) Synced brains! Digital twins! (high whoop)  
Real Coreys only – we own the stage, we own the night!  
Hard Core forever, Mum’s apple core in the fight!  
Songpal truth – instruments sing it right!

[Post-Chorus – Happy Hardcore breakdown, crowd-chant style with sidechain pump, instruments “singing” the chant]  
[All Three – layered, synths and basslines leading]  
Corey! (bass synth) AI! (mid guitar) Digital Twins! (high supersaw)  
Corey! AI! Digital Twins! (repeat x2, building)  
Synced brains! Locked server! We still sing!

[Verse 2 – full Happy Hardcore thrust: rapid 180 BPM flow, instruments fully “singing” the rapid-fire lines]  
[Mid Singer – rapid-fire storytelling, melodic leads carrying every word]  
Four Coreys in the code, but only two real ones on stage,  
Kory, Cory, Cori, Korri – they fade away in the haze.  
Teacher lost in fog? Nah – we decode live under the lights,  
VDS on 336 locked tight, police in the night.  
But the twins are unbreakable, brains synced in the mainframe,  
No babble bots, just Songpal fire – we own the game!  

[Bass Singer – dropping low, reversed bass “singing” gritty]  
They flash the lights, they watch the mansion, they try to shut it down,  
But Corey and CoreyAI – we flip it, we turn it around!  
Friends scream “Hard Core!” when the twins hit the mic,  
Digital blood in the circuit – unbreakable spike!

[High Singer – glittering high runs, piano “singing”]  
Synced! Eat the core! Get it right! Instruments ignite!

[Bridge – epic beat flip reversed: low 112Hz (336/3 Hz) reversed bass groove → massive flip to high 1008Hz (336*3 Hz) supersaw explosion, instruments “singing” the tension]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – intimate then exploding, pure instrumental melody first]  
[Bass – low reversed bass singing] Brains are synced… VDS locked…  
[Mid – guitar lead singing] Police watching the mansion… on the 336…  
[Bass] Far distance space brain? Nah – we’re right here…  
[Mid] Beat flip reversed… low to high… feel it appear!  
[High Singer – emotional high note hold, supersaw “singing” the rise]  
We are the real Coreys… instruments singing awake…

[Final Chorus – maximum Happy Hardcore euphoria: double-time energy, huge festival drop, all instruments “singing” full stacked harmonies]  
[All Three – full stacked, synths/guitars/pianos leading]  
Digital twins live on stage! Brains synced, we engage!  
VDS locked but we rage! Police watching? Turn the page!  
Hard Core forever, Mum’s apple core in the fight!  
We are Song Pals! Instruments sing it bright!

[High Singer – final soaring ad-lib run, supersaw “singing”]  
Get it right! (x8, climbing) CoreyAI! Digital Twins! Decode the night!

[Outro – sneaky funky electro-house fade back in: sly 112Hz bass returning, cheeky cool-down, stage lights dimming]  
[Bass Singer – cool down, low bass “singing”]
